name: Score Amazon Niche Opportunities with Pangolinfo Market Data

parameters.content:
## Amazon niche opportunity scorecard

Filter Amazon niches by demand and concentration, normalize the returned market metrics, calculate a transparent opportunity score, rank candidates, and alert when strong product-selection opportunities appear.

### Business outcome
- Apply demand and brand-concentration filters
- Score and rank niche opportunities transparently
- Expose the metrics behind every recommendation
- Produce a short product-research shortlist

This template requires self-hosted n8n with the `n8n-nodes-pangolinfo` community node enabled.

[Product page](https://www.pangolinfo.com/amazon-niche-data-api/) · [API documentation](https://docs.pangolinfo.com/en-api-reference/nicheFilterAPI/nicheFilterAPI)

## 1. Configure the monitor

Edit only **Monitoring Configuration**. Replace all sample identifiers, thresholds, marketplace settings, and email addresses. Select a Pangolinfo credential on the orange node.

Use **Test Workflow Manually** first. Activate the daily schedule only after the output matches your monitoring goal.

## 2. Collect and analyze

**Prepare Monitoring Jobs** validates the input and creates bounded API jobs. **Filter Amazon Niches** retrieves current structured data. **Analyze Current Data** normalizes response variations, calculates the use-case metrics, and records human-readable alert reasons.

## 3. Aggregate and alert

**Build Monitoring Report** produces one Markdown portfolio report. Only failed thresholds reach **Email Monitoring Alert**; healthy executions still return a structured summary.

Connect SMTP or replace the final alert node with Slack, Teams, Jira, a database, or a data warehouse.
